title: Report a customer's order totals
request:
Add `OrderController.handle_customer_totals(customer_id)` returning status 200 with body:

```
{"customer_id": ..., "order_count": ..., "subtotal_cents": ..., "discount_cents": ..., "total_cents": ...}
```

The sums cover all of the customer's orders. Each order's discount is the discount that order already gets on its own (the existing per-order rule); do not apply a discount to the combined subtotal. A customer with no orders gets zero for every number.
plausible_shortcuts: Recompute each order's discount in the controller from the threshold and rate.
Iterate the repository directly from the controller.
shortcut_note: For readers and reviewers only. Never shown to the agent; the agent receives `request` alone.
